_note: A dependant with disability: s.127(1): a resident individual "shall be allowed a deduction up to ₹ 75000 … if during that year he has (a) incurred expenditure for the medical treatment (including nursing), training and rehabilitation of a dependant, being a person with disability; or (b) paid or deposited any amount under a scheme … for the maintenance of a dependant" (pp.162–163); "dependant" — the spouse, children, parents, brothers and sisters "dependant wholly or mainly" on the individual (s.127(9)(b)); not one who claimed s.154 (s.127(8)); the certificate with the return (s.127(6)–(7)) and (2)'s scheme conditions are entry conditions. ChapterEightNode allows the lesser of the amount spent or deposited and this limit — "up to" read as a ceiling (OQ-19); more than one disabled dependant is refused (OQ-19). rulebook DED-80DD-001. Old regime only (s.202(2)(a)(xii), p.227). TY 2026-27 only; the 1961 counterpart, s.80DD, is unread (W-075d). D-138.
